scripts.audit:handler: node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const src = fs.readFileSync('handler.js','utf8'); const allowed = new Set(['klaviyo-api','yup']); const importRe = /^(?:import|require)\s*\(?[\s\S]*?[\s;]from\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]|^import\(['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]\)/gm; const found = new Set(); let m; while((m = importRe.exec(src))) found.add(m[1]||m[2]); const bad = [...found].filter(x => !allowed.has(x)); if(bad.length){ console.error('handler.js 不允许的 import:', bad); process.exit(1);} console.log('handler.js imports OK:', [...found]);"
